Loop Financial| Senior Frontend Engineer, Senior Backend Engineer | Toronto (In-office) | Full-time

Loop is a fintech/payments company based in Toronto, building the infrastructure that moves money and we're growing the engineering team that makes it happen.

Hiring:

*Senior Frontend Engineer* - You'll own the user-facing product experience. Strong React skills, high craft bar, comfortable working close to the product.

*Senior Backend Engineer* - You'll work on the core payments platform. We care about reliability, scale, and engineers who think deeply about systems.

Apply: https://www.bankonloop.com/en-ca/careers
